title: Welcome to Gemini at Work 2026: Introducing the Gemini agent
quote: Agents today are fragmented across different tools. We built one agent that can do all of this from one prompt box, one API. You give it an objective, not a set of instructions, and it plans the work, uses skills and tools, and gives you a finished result.

title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
quote: Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said the agent can be given objectives, not just instructions.

title: Goodfire says its new inside-out monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
quote: Monitoring about 1 million exchanges cost roughly $185 using Goodfire approach, versus $5,420 for a cheaper AI monitor checking every step and about $200,000 for a top-tier one. The probes caught 93% of malicious hacking sessions.

title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
quote: The optimized workflow is 76x cheaper and 5x faster than the original production setup. Average estimated model cost is $0.47 per run, down from at least $36.21, and a run takes about four minutes instead of at least 22.5 minutes.

title: What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models
quote: Existing probes suffer from poor generalization to distribution shifts commonly encountered in production environments, particularly when processing long-context inputs. The persistent vulnerability to adaptive attacks underscores the need for multi-layered defense strategies.
